label: Bible Study
prompt: Blessed are the _____ in spirit: for their's is the kingdom of heaven.
verse: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for their's is the kingdom of heaven.
note: The first Beatitude — the Sermon on the Mount opens with a blessing for the spiritually broke.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: I say unto you, that likewise _____ shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.
verse: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.
note: Heaven throws a bigger party for one returning sheep than for ninety-nine that never wandered.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he said unto them, Out of the eater came forth meat, and out of the strong came forth _____. And they could not in three days expound the riddle.
verse: And he said unto them, Out of the eater came forth meat, and out of the strong came forth sweetness. And they could not in three days expound the riddle.
note: Samson's riddle came from a lion's carcass full of bees — impossible to guess unless you'd been there.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But they shall sit every man under his _____ and under his fig tree; and none shall make them afraid: for the mouth of the LORD of hosts hath spoken it.
verse: But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree; and none shall make them afraid: for the mouth of the LORD of hosts hath spoken it.
note: Micah's peace picture — every family under its own vine and fig tree; George Washington loved quoting it in his letters.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But one thing is _____: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.
verse: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.
note: Martha's kitchen, Mary's seat: 'one thing is needful.' Perhaps Jesus' gentlest correction.
